prompted_for: Home section 'How a project runs': design, fabricate, test, qualify, support; first prompt (blueprint style): five steps along one continuous isometric pipe with equipment per step (desk, frame, tanks, panel)
composition: wide panel on warm limestone/paper ground
large light headline top left inside crop-mark brackets with small 'STEP 01 / STEP 05' tags
five step labels with superscript numbers in a row above the drawing
one thick isometric pipe snakes left to right through five vignettes: drawing desk and screens, steel frame, tanks and gauges, control panel with checkmarks, storage tank and outlets
labels repeated below the drawing for steps 2 to 5 (generator duplication)
flow arrows in steel-blue at both ends
layout_devices: floating mini-panels (screens, charts, checklists) beside equipment
palette: deep navy line work and type
steel-blue accent on flow arrows and a few highlights
very faint white fill on tanks
typography: light sans step labels with small superscript mono-style numerals 01-05
tiny mono tags and coordinates near headline
rendering: flat with subtle white fills on vessels
line_and_texture: subtle paper tone, no visible grain
motifs: storage tank with outlet valves and a small chart (support)
motion_implied: water travels the pipe step to step
each step label highlights as flow arrives
checkmarks tick on in the qualify panel
t2i_keywords: one continuous pipe snaking left to right
five numbered stages in a row
steel-blue flow arrows as single accent
small floating UI panels with charts and checkmarks
t2i_prompt: A wide web page section on a warm limestone paper background, drawn as a light engineering sheet. A large light thin sans-serif headline sits top left inside small crop-mark brackets. A row of step labels with tiny superscript numerals runs above an isometric navy hairline drawing: one continuous pipe snakes left to right through a vignette for each step: <CONTENT>. Small floating panels with charts and checkmarks, dimension lines and faint extension lines add detail. Steel-blue flow arrows are the only accent. A small title block sits bottom right. Flat, no shadows, generous spacing, no people.
signature_idea: The project timeline is a physical pipe: water literally flows from the design desk through fabrication, testing and qualification to support.
strengths: navy on limestone with one steel-blue accent is almost exactly the brand palette
pipe-as-timeline is a memorable, animatable metaphor
each vignette is readable at a glance
light headline and superscript numerals feel precise
weaknesses: labels duplicated below the drawing (generator error)
dense middle band with small details that will not survive phone width
vignettes mix scales (desk vs skid vs tank) which reads slightly toy-like
brand_fit_why: Limestone ground, navy hairlines, single steel-blue accent, light headline and square corners all match; only the busy middle band and duplicated labels hold it back.
